# Mashed

> > Mashed is a food and culinary lifestyle publication covering fast food chains, celebrity chefs, cooking tips, and food culture trends.

Mashed delivers engaging content about restaurant comparisons, brand mascots, celebrity recipes and diets, kitchen organization hacks, and regional fast food variations. The site explores everything from McDonald's international menu differences to Martha Stewart's cooking innovations and food industry personalities.

## Key Topics

- McDonald's international menus
- Fast food regional variations
- Celebrity cooking and recipes
- Kitchen organization and storage
- Food brand mascots and history
- Italian fast food exclusives
- Martha Stewart recipes
- Celebrity diet and beverages
- Dollar Tree kitchen solutions
- Puff pastry cooking techniques
- Raw milk and wellness trends
- Quick recipe hacks
- Fast food menu comparisons
- Brand mascot evolution
- Affordable home organization

## Fast Food & Restaurant Comparisons

- [How American McDonald's Burgers Differ From Italy's](https://www.mashed.com/312257/how-american-mcdonalds-burgers-differ-from-italys/): Comparison of McDonald's burger offerings between America and Italy

## Celebrity Food & Recipes

- [Martha Stewart's 2-Ingredient Stuffed Waffles Will Have You Ghosting Eggo By Next Week](https://www.mashed.com/2062903/martha-stewart-two-ingredient-waffles-puff-pastry-chocolate/): Martha Stewart's simple puff pastry waffle recipe with chocolate filling
- [What Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Typically Drinks](https://www.mashed.com/1788653/what-robert-f-kennedy-jr-drinks/): Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s beverage choices including raw milk advocacy

## Food Brand History & Culture

- [The Untold Truth Of Chester Cheetah](https://www.mashed.com/297982/the-untold-truth-of-chester-cheetah/): History and evolution of Chester Cheetah, the Cheetos brand mascot
